title: Wringer gate proposals
description: A `wringer.gatespec.v1` document — proposed acceptance gates, each naming the criterion it would evidence. Source, not evidence: it lives in the repository beside `wringer.spec.yaml`. It exists because `wringer.spec.v1` is frozen and its `gates:` entries have no `proves` channel (SPEC_GATEGEN_V0, ruling 1). **This file has no authority.** No gate in it ever runs, nothing under `.wringer/` is written from it, and `verify`, `run`, `fleet`, `graph` and `deliver` never read it. It becomes real only when a person applies the diff `wring plan` prints to `.wringer.yaml`, which remains the only file that puts a command in Wringer's mouth. `wring spec --send` writes one from the drafted criteria; an offline repo writes the same file by hand and everything downstream is identical.

gates.description: One proposal per criterion a machine can decide. Never one for a `human: true` criterion — a command claiming to evidence judgement is a category error the config loader already refuses.

id.description: The gate id it would have in `.wringer.yaml`: it becomes a directory name in the evidence bundle.

run.description: The command a person would install. Drafted by a model here and executed by nothing until a human has copied it into `.wringer.yaml` themselves.

timeout.description: Seconds. Omitted means the config default.

proves.description: The id of the criterion in `wringer.spec.yaml` this gate would evidence. Required here: this file is the binding channel, and a gate that evidences no criterion belongs in the spec's own `gates:` block.
